definitions.explanation: A dark, rich shade of green. Used to describe colors in nature, clothing, and design.

examples.japanese: {深緑|ふかみどり}の{森|もり}が{広|ひろ}がっている。
examples.english: A deep green forest stretches out.

examples.japanese: {深緑|ふかみどり}のコートを{買|か}った。
examples.english: I bought a dark green coat.

examples.japanese: {夏|なつ}になると{山|やま}の{木々|きぎ}が{深緑|ふかみどり}に{染|そ}まる。
examples.english: In summer, the mountain trees turn deep green.

notes:
A traditional Japanese color name describing a rich, dark shade of green. Evokes the lush greenery of midsummer forests.

FORMS:
{深|ふか} (deep) + {緑|みどり} (green)

SIMILAR COLOR TERMS:
- {新緑|しんりょく}: fresh green (of new spring leaves) — lighter and brighter
- {若緑|わかみどり}: young green — a light, yellowish green of early growth
- {濃緑|のうりょく}: dense/dark green — more technical, used in color specifications
- {萌黄|もえぎ}: yellowish green — a lighter, more vivid traditional color

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {深緑|ふかみどり}の{季節|きせつ}: the season of deep green (midsummer)
- {深緑|ふかみどり}に{染|そ}まる: to be dyed deep green
- {深緑|ふかみどり}の{葉|は}: deep green leaves
